text.p: These are the leading stories in the Beirut press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
-President Hrawi discussed bilateral issues with Syrian President Assad by telephone.
-Brazil's president will visit Lebanon in 1998, Brazilian Foreign Minister Lamperia said at the end of a four-day visit to Lebanon
-Lebanon's 1996 trade deficit widened by $53.3 million to $6,532.3 million.
-Prime Minister Hariri discussed the regional situation with top Syrian officials in Damascus.
-Foreign Minister Bouez will meet his French counterpart de Charette in Paris on Tuesday.
-Israeli shelling on suspected pro-Iranian Hizbollah positions in south Lebanon.
-The Council for Development and Reconstruction signed a $198 million deal with German firm Zublin to construct seven new faculty buildings at the new campus of state-run Lebanese University.
-Armenia's Foreign Minister will pay a three-day visit to Lebanon on March 11.
-Banque du Liban et d'Outre Mer reported increases of 28.5 percent in profits in 1996.
-A high level Syrian delegation will visit Lebanon within a few days.
-The Bank of Lebanon issued 45- and 60-day certificates of deposit dated February 7 to commercial banks worth 84 billion Lebanese pounds.
